newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai PTT, Chevron in aromatic venture.
newsitem.headline: Thai PTT, Chevron in aromatic venture.

text.p: The Thai cabinet on Tuesday approved a plan for the state-owned Petroleum Authority of Thailand (PTT) to launch a $1.2 billion aromatic joint venture with Chevron Corp's Chevron Chemical Co unit in eastern Thailand.
The venture's aromatic plant is due to start producing 675,000 tonnes of paraxylene and 600,000 tonnes of benzenes a year from late 2000.
A PTT statement said the Thai national oil company would hold a 40 percent stake in the project with Chevron owning the rest.

It said the biggest Thai aromatic plant will export two thirds of its output to Asian and Pacific countries including China, South Korea, Malaysia and Taiwan, earning Thailand about $440 million in annual foreign exchange.
A government spokesman said of the projected $1.2 billion investment, 25-35 percent would be made through equity injection and the rest financed by loans.
